name: Ablative Spellwork
body:
You can convert some of a spell’s power into minor protection.

Prerequisite(s): Spellcraft 3 ranks, ability to cast 2nd level spells.

Benefit: Whenever you cast a spell of 1st level or higher you gain damage reduction until the beginning of your next turn. This is DR x/magic where x is 1/2 the level of the spell you cast, rounded up. This requires no action.
